study: Topology-derived six-worker CPU placement, real-model screening
scope: Owned Windows process, same binary/kernel/data/thread count, scheduler-selected vs one topology-derived fixed placement. Whole-execution placement including caller; neither isolated migration/SMT attribution nor HF/mx gate.

plan.scope: Real-model scratch placement comparison, identical binary and original runtime source. Only owned child worker thread affinity differs; no production feature or external mx/HF gate claim.
plan.order: Pairs -1,0,1,2,3,4. Odd pairs (including -1): models 8b then0.6b, arms fixed then scheduler. Even pairs: models0.6b then8b, arms scheduler thenfixed. One internal warmup then one measured pp215/tg32 per process; all24 invocations and both internal records retained.
plan.mapping: Query single-group physical core masks and child allowed process mask, sort by lowest allowed LP and pick first6 distinct cores. Include caller0. Abort unsupported topology. No post-result map search.
plan.timing_boundary: Weights/model/pool created before affinity. Apply/witness outside clocks; model.reset outside clock; time actual prefill then forced32 step calls. Hash/write/placement checks outside clocks. Exact final warmup/measured bits within invocation and all saved vectors within each model must match across arms.
plan.advance_rule: Both models: fixed mean AND median decode tok/s >=0.5% above scheduler, and at least4/5 strict paired decode wins. Neither model prefill mean nor median may regress more than3%. Requires all conditions. Otherwise retain scheduler behavior and stop this fixed-placement hypothesis.
plan.prerequisites: Placement correctness, exception restoration, independent source/harness review pass; all builds/checks terminal; verified immutable sources/binary/inputs and empty process guards; no concurrent timing/model/build work.
plan.limits: No proof of full-corpus/HF correctness or mx floor. Final vectors cover final position only. Fixed placement effect combines scheduling, migration, SMT, cache and boost; none isolated. Same physical cores are not reserved from other work. No cross-platform production affinity promise.

from pathlib import Path
import datetime,hashlib,json,math,os,statistics,struct,subprocess
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
out=root/'timing';out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
plan=json.loads((root/'plan.json').read_text())
def sha(p):
    with Path(p).open('rb') as f:return hashlib.file_digest(f,'sha256').hexdigest()
def now():return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
def guard():
    cmd="Get-Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.ProcessName -match '^(llmx.*|llama.*|candidate-compare.*|control-compare.*|placement-.*|matrix|oracle|driver|check|cl|cmake|ninja|g\\+\\+)$' } | Select-Object Id,ProcessName | ConvertTo-Json -Compress"
    return subprocess.check_output(['powershell','-NoProfile','-Command',cmd],text=True).strip()
placement_signature=None
def check_placement(doc,arm,caller):
    global placement_signature
    before,after,restored=[doc[k] for k in ['before','after','restored']]
    allowed=before['process_mask'];system=before['system_mask'];assert allowed>0 and allowed&~system==0
    topology=before['topology'];seen=0;eligible=[]
    for core in topology:
        mask=core['mask'];assert core['group']==0 and mask>0 and not mask&seen
        seen|=mask
        if mask&allowed:eligible.append(mask&allowed)
    assert allowed&~seen==0 and len(eligible)>=6
    selected=sorted(m&-m for m in eligible)[:6]
    signature=(allowed,system,tuple(sorted((x['group'],x['mask'],x['flags'],x['efficiency_class']) for x in topology)),tuple(selected))
    if placement_signature is None:placement_signature=signature
    assert signature==placement_signature,'topology or mapping changed across invocations'
    ids=[w['thread_id'] for w in before['workers']];assert len(ids)==6 and len(set(ids))==6 and ids[0]==caller
    for phase,snapshot in [('before',before),('after',after),('restored',restored)]:
        assert snapshot['mode']==('fixed' if arm=='fixed' else 'unbound')
        assert snapshot['process_mask']==allowed and snapshot['system_mask']==system and snapshot['topology']==topology
        assert snapshot['restored']==(phase=='restored')
        assert len(snapshot['workers'])==6
        for i,w in enumerate(snapshot['workers']):
            assert w['worker']==i and w['thread_id']==ids[i] and w['captured'] and not w['injected']
            assert w['old_mask']==allowed and w['target_mask']==selected[i]
            active=selected[i] if arm=='fixed' else allowed
            assert w['applied_return']==(allowed if arm=='fixed' else 0)
            assert w['applied_mask']==active and w['applied_group']==0 and 0<=w['applied_cpu']<64 and active&(1<<w['applied_cpu'])
            assert w['verified_mask']==active and w['verified_group']==0 and 0<=w['verified_cpu']<64 and active&(1<<w['verified_cpu'])
            assert w['current_mask']==(allowed if phase=='restored' else active)
            assert w['observed_group']==0 and 0<=w['observed_cpu']<64 and w['current_mask']&(1<<w['observed_cpu'])
            assert w['changed']==(arm=='fixed' and phase!='restored') and w['restored']==(phase=='restored')
            assert w['restore_return']==(selected[i] if arm=='fixed' and phase=='restored' else 0)
            assert w['verified_active']>=2
    for i in range(6):
        assert after['workers'][i]['verified_active']==before['workers'][i]['verified_active']+1
        assert restored['workers'][i]['verified_active']==after['workers'][i]['verified_active']

state={'status':'preparing','pid':os.getpid(),'started':now(),'plan':plan,'plan_sha256':sha(root/'plan.json'),'runner_sha256':sha(__file__),'manifest_sha256':sha(root/'manifest.json'),'rows':[],'models':[]}
def save():(out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(state,indent=2)+'\n')

    expected={};state['status']='running';save()

                row={'name':name,'pair':pair,'model':model['name'],'arm':arm,'command':command,'started':now(),'before':active,'status':'running'}
                state['rows'].append(row);save();print('START',name,flush=True)
                with (out/(name+'.stdout')).open('wb') as stdout,(out/(name+'.stderr')).open('wb') as stderr:
                    child=subprocess.Popen(command,stdout=stdout,stderr=stderr);row['pid']=child.pid;save()
                    try:rc=child.wait(timeout=300)

                raw=(out/(name+'.f32')).read_bytes();assert len(raw)==doc['vocab']*4
                assert all(math.isfinite(v[0]) for v in struct.iter_unpack('<f',raw))

                assert len(samples)==5

            a,b=item['scheduler'],item['fixed']

            item['fixed_wins']=sum(y>x for x,y in zip(a['samples'],b['samples']))

    state.update(status='pass',completed=now(),summary=summary,screening_advance=advance);save()
